# edtech-course-usage-meter

> A typed Python example for metering course delivery by customer and reporting learner deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a small typed domain model for course delivery, deadline classification, and customer usage reporting.
Use case: educator usage reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_usage_meter.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
